description: Create a Stripe checkout link for the option the user picked from wpconvert_plans. Call this only after the user has chosen; pass that choice's checkout_arguments unchanged. Needs a signed-in account (wpconvert_connect kind "login"). Returns a link the user opens to pay; never open it yourself and never pay on their behalf.

jobId.description: Conversion to unlock. Required for starter.

name: wpconvert_checkout
